svg.aria-label: Decode at batch 1 × 32k on an H100: without a split, 8 CTAs leave 94% of the SMs idle; FA3 in vLLM makes 120 CTAs with 15 splits, and the fp32 partials cost 0.7% of the K/V traffic.
svg.title: Decode at batch 1 × 32k on an H100: without a split, 8 CTAs leave 94% of the SMs idle; FA3 in vLLM makes 120 CTAs with 15 splits, and the fp32 partials cost 0.7% of the K/V traffic.

g.text: Decode at batch 1 × 32k on an H100 (132 SMs), Llama-3-8B shapes: 8 KV heads, g = 4 query heads packed in one tile (§6.3)
no split: 8 CTAs, one per KV head, each walks all 32,768 tokens: 94% of the SMs are idle
FA3 in vLLM: 15 splits, 120 CTAs, approximately one wave
FA2 (flash_attn_with_kvcache): 29 splits, 232 CTAs, the target is two CTAs per SM
one CTA per (batch, KV head, split)
online softmax over its KV range
FA2, 29 splits: 475 KB + 3.7 KB of LSEs
against 134 MB of K/V per layer (0.7%)
The split count depends on the batch size and the SM count, and so does the order of the final sum (§9.3).
When the batch fills the machine by itself (64 × 4k: 512 CTAs), the split count decreases to 1.
